data.name: Adlii
data.gender_notes: Adlii is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'adl, meaning 'justice' or 'righteousness'. In Islamic tradition, Adlii is a name given to children born into just and fair circumstances, symbolizing the virtues of fairness and righteousness. The name Adlii carries the meaning “Justice, Righteousness” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Adlii usually hope their child will grow to embody justice, righteousness and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes the pursuit of truth and justice in the spiritual realm, inspiring its bearer to live a virtuous and righteous life.
data.etymology: Adlii belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Justice, Righteousness.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Adlii total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: عدلي
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم مشتق من جذر عدل، يدل على معنى العدل والإنصاف والمساواة، وهو من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني القيم والفضائل الإسلامية العالية، مثل الإنصاف والتعادل في الحكم والتصرفات، وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قول الله تعالى: ﴿ولا يجرمنكم شناءة قوم على أن لا تعدلوا اعدلوا هو أقرب للتقوى﴾

in_urdu.name: عدلی
